Gaden Hub: PNG's digital home for farmers

The free community and marketplace for Papua New Guinea's farmers, buyers and customers. Sell produce, share your harvest, ask questions and find farmers in all 22 provinces.

What you can do on Gaden Hub

  • Sell and buy produce, livestock, cash crops and farm services
  • Find farmers by province, district and commodity
  • Join the farming community and ask questions
  • Check prices and read farming guides
  • Safety and community rules
